subject: Tiered GPU rollout & tempo negotiation — multi-year prepay
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily@fluxlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Tiered GPU rollout & tempo negotiation — multi-year prepay

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Per Flux's ask, you wanted a clear multi-year prepay option that lets you:
- start with a smaller GPU/TPM footprint in Y1,
- scale to target capacity across Y2–Y3, and
- retain a predictable blended per-token rate with an annual true-up.

Attached is a first-pass ramp schedule (Proposed_Ramp_Schedule_v3.xlsx) and a short SOW sketch. The key trade-offs we see:
- Deeper upfront prepay -> larger term discount;
- Phased onramp -> higher unit price in year 1 but lower churn risk;
- TPM guarantees vs elastic burst lanes impact billing mechanics.

Can you confirm whether Flux needs firm TPM minimums per month, or whether a monthly committed GPU tranche with burstable TPM is acceptable? That determines the billing carve-out and discount thresholds we can offer.

Proposed next step: you + procurement review the attachments and tell us which of these two commitment shapes you prefer by end of week. Ben and Monica are on copy for pricing/legal follow-up.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Strategic Sales — Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0124
attachments: Proposed_Ramp_Schedule_v3.xlsx, FluxLabs_SOW_Draft.pdf

From: Emily Zhao <emily@fluxlabs.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@fluxlabs.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Tiered GPU rollout & tempo negotiation — multi-year prepay

Logan —

Thanks for the file. Quick answers from our side:
- We prefer a committed GPU tranche (monthly GPU units by quarter) with burstable TPM — procurement needs the hard GPU numbers for capacity planning.
- Flux is looking at a 3-year term with an annual true-up and a target 30–40% blended discount vs list across the commit. Year 1 will likely be 25% of target capacity, Year 2 60%, Year 3 100%.

Procurement has requested a counter with:
1) an explicit milestone-based invoice schedule tied to GPU delivery windows,
2) an option to accelerate Year 2 onboarding subject to a credit application, and
3) clearer language about overage billing and how burst capacity is charged.

I've attached procurement's redline summary (sending separately). Can Ben/Laura propose concrete discount breakpoints for the 3-yr blended target?

Best,
Emily Zhao
Head of ML Platforms, Flux Labs
attachments: procurement_redlines.xlsx (sent separately)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily@fluxlabs.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Tiered GPU rollout & tempo negotiation — multi-year prepay

Emily —

Appreciate the clarity. Based on the 25/60/100 ramp profile you described, here's a pricing framework we can propose as a starting point (high level):

- List baseline: standard Dedicated per-GPU per-month and per-TPM rates.
- Blended discount ladder (applies to committed spend only):
  * 0–33% of target committed across term: 15% off list
  * 34–66%: 25% off list
  * 67–100%: 35% off list
- Year 1 concession: to enable the smaller ramp, we add a temporary 5% credit applied to Year 1 invoices (one-time) if you hit an accelerated Year 2 trigger.
- Invoice cadence: quarterly invoicing by default; milestone invoices for large up-front prepay tranches (we can map to the GPU delivery windows).

Open items we need to confirm with legal/finance: amortization of prepaid credits, refund/transfer policy for unused committed GPUs in year 1, and the exact definition of burst TPM pricing. Laura, can you weigh in on the amortization/contract language?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily@fluxlabs.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T14:44:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Tiered GPU rollout & tempo negotiation — multi-year prepay

Ben/Logan —

Quick legal/contract note for Emily and procurement:

- Amortization: prepaid credits will amortize monthly over the year they cover; for multi-year prepay, credits amortize over each respective contract year unless Flux elects to pre-fund multiple years (we will show amortization schedule in SOW).
- Unused committed GPUs in Year 1: we are open to a one-time transfer of up to 20% of Year 1 committed GPUs to Year 2, provided Flux submits an intent-to-transfer 30 days prior to year-end. Remaining unused units convert to a non-refundable credit unless otherwise negotiated.
- Burstable TPMs: charged at the committed TPM rate up to the commit; bursts billed at a fixed overage rate per TPM-minute. We'll include an example calculation in the SOW.
- Milestone invoicing: we can support invoice triggers tied to shipment/availability windows; finance will require clear acceptance criteria (e.g., capacity availability in region).

If that is acceptable, Monica can produce a revised SOW and invoice cadence for Emily to review.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference

From: Emily Zhao <emily@fluxlabs.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@fluxlabs.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Tiered GPU rollout & tempo negotiation — multi-year prepay

Team —

Thanks — the framework looks promising. Procurement asked for two concrete changes before we can proceed to internal approval:
1) Increase the Year 1 transfer allowance from 20% -> 30% (we expect variability in our early usage).
2) Add an option for a twice-per-term true-up (annual + mid-term) if Flux opts into an accelerated Year 2 onboarding.

If Redwood can accommodate those, procurement will prioritize the SOW review and aim to return a signed paper within two weeks. We still need a short worked example showing the blended effective rate under the 25/60/100 ramp with the proposed discount ladder — that will help our CFO.

Emily Zhao
Head of ML Platforms, Flux Labs

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily@fluxlabs.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T16:48:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Tiered GPU rollout & tempo negotiation — multi-year prepay

Emily/Team —

We can accommodate both asks with the following concessions to keep commercial balance:
- Year 1 transfer allowance increased to 30% (one-time transfer window, notify 30 days prior to year-end).
- Twice-per-term true-up option — standard annual true-up plus a mid-term true-up triggered only if Flux elects the accelerated Year 2 onboarding; mid-term true-up will require a small administrative fee to cover reconciliation costs.

Action items:
- Monica to publish revised SOW + worked example of blended rate (will include amortization table and one accelerated onboarding example). Target: draft SOW to Emily by 2026-11-25.
- Logan to confirm whether Flux will pursue the accelerated Year 2 trigger (tentative).

If these align, we will prepare a DocuSign packet and a milestone invoice schedule.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Sr. Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
attachments: Proposed_Ramp_Schedule_v3.xlsx, FluxLabs_SOW_Draft.pdf
